answer: The strongest lever is simple: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because sable only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, gale is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any timber approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
